description.en: A remote island in the middle of the South Pacific, There is an impregnable nursing home from which no elderly person can escape. The 73-year-old old who lost his wife and is preparing for the end of his life As soon as you enter the facility, you will be greeted by the enthusiastic welcome ceremony of the elderly. In an environment where everything is unfamiliar, instead of the unique adaptability of old fashion, Demonstrating his unique force, he became a hot topic He meets Mrs. Kang, who looks exactly like his wife, and falls in love with her. However, in the meantime, the nursing home He is targeted by the dark forces of the ‘Longevity Senior Citizens’ Association’, The old man fought fiercely with the senior citizens’ association officials, He develops a love for Mrs. Kang. After finding hope for life again, Noh escaped from the nursing home with Mrs. Kang. I’m trying to build a new life, Jo Bang-cheol, the president of the senior citizens’ association and the hidden director of the nursing home, interferes with this. How will the old style survive in the face of an unstoppable power? Boom!!
